results.answer: Lessons begin at 07:45 in the morning [S1].
If a learner is late three times in one term, they must serve a Friday detention from 13:30 to 14:30 [S1]. Additionally, the class teacher will inform the parents in writing [S1].

Yes, learners may bring a cellphone to school for safety reasons [S1]. 

The phone must be switched off and handed to the class teacher at 07:45, and it is returned to the learner at 13:45 [S1].
If your daughter is being bullied, you or your learner should report it to the grade head within 24 hours [S1].
Ten demerits in a term lead to a meeting with the principal [S1].
The annual school fee for a Grade 2 learner is R24 000 [S1].
Yes, parents who pay the full annual fee by 31 January receive a 5 percent discount [S1].
Interest of 1.5 percent per month is charged on any amount that is more than 30 days overdue [S1].
The third child receives a 20 percent discount on fees [S1].

To apply for a fee exemption, you need to submit form F1 along with proof of income to the fees committee [S1]. The deadline for your application is 31 March [S1]. 

If you need any further help, please contact the school office.
No, trainers are only allowed for physical education lessons and sport [S1]. Learners wear black leather lace-up school shoes [S1].
The only jewellery allowed is a watch and one pair of plain stud earrings [S1].
The second-hand uniform shop is open on Wednesdays from 07:15 to 08:00 in the school hall [S1].

When a learner misses a formal test, you need to provide a medical certificate or a letter from the parent to the class teacher within three school days [S1]. Once this is done, your son will be able to write a catch-up test [S1]. Without a valid reason and this documentation, a missed test will receive a mark of zero [S1].
Learners in Grades 4 to 7 receive about 45 minutes of homework each school day, and no homework is given on Fridays [S1].
To be promoted to the next grade, a learner must pass Home Language with at least 50 percent and Mathematics with at least 40 percent [S1].
The Route A bus leaves the Hillcrest stop at 06:50 in the morning [S1].
Parents' evening is on Thursday 20 February at 17:30 in the school hall [S1].

For a learner in Grade 6, the monthly school fee instalment is R2 760 [S1]. The bus service costs R650 per learner per month [S2]. 

Paid together, the total monthly amount for school fees and transport is R3 410 [S1][S2].

For physical education, learners wear their house T-shirt, navy shorts, and white trainers [S1]. Trainers are also allowed for sport [S3]. 

The afternoon bus leaves the school at 14:10 [S2].

If your child is late for school three times in one term, they must serve a Friday detention from 13:30 to 14:30, and the class teacher will inform you in writing [S2]. 

If your child misses a formal test without a valid reason (such as a medical certificate or a parent's letter brought to the class teacher within three school days), they will receive a mark of zero [S1].

If a learner misbehaves on the bus, they are suspended from the bus service for one week, and their parents are informed in writing [S1]. 

Bullying in any form, including online bullying, is considered a serious offence [S2].
